summary: On 10 Sep 2026, Kavya Srinivasan, CISO of Tarang Payments, emailed Rahul Verma requesting the SOC2 report and RBI data‑localisation note that were promised by 9 Sep. She noted the vendor risk committee meeting on 25 Sep and said she needs at least a week to review the documents. The requested security documents have not yet been received, creating a delay in the evaluation process.
